shared_elements: carved stone monument in low relief
circular disc motif (plain incised circle vs. spoked wheel)
incised linear detail on a weathered grey-brown stone surface
repeated small motifs arranged in a band or row
justification: Both are grey-brown stone surfaces worked in shallow relief with incised outlines, and each includes an anthropomorphic form and a prominent circular disc (a plain incised ring on A, a spoked wheel on B), plus rows of repeated small motifs. Beyond those generic traits the works diverge completely: A is a three-dimensional, heavily weathered anthropomorphic block with sparse, schematic, symmetrically placed emblems, while B is a flat rectangular panel filled with a detailed, directional narrative scene of figures, animals and a vehicle over a patterned ground.
